name: CA-03
label: Safe D

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Ami Bera: a D+6 district, incumbency, a favorable environment, and a dominant fundraising edge over Robb Tucker, who has just $16,000 on hand. Markets price Bera near 95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Bera or an unexpectedly strong Republican environment could narrow the margin, though an upset remains unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
Ami Bera, the Democratic incumbent, advanced to the general election in a Sacramento-area district that leans Democratic by about six points. He faces Republican Robb Tucker, a first-time challenger with minimal resources. Bera has raised $1.25 million and holds $1.8 million on hand, while Tucker has $16,000, giving the incumbent an overwhelming financial advantage.

No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive. Prediction markets put Bera's chances around 95 percent. With the fundamentals, money, and markets all aligned, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of direct polling rather than any sign of a genuine contest.
